Container.Name: MoviePilot-V3
Container.Overview: MoviePilot V3 is an automation hub for a home media library. It watches your subscriptions, searches your indexers, hands the release to your existing BitTorrent client, then renames, hardlinks and scrapes the finished files into a clean library and refreshes your media server.[br][br] Highlights:[br] - Subscribe to movies and TV shows and let MoviePilot find and download them automatically.[br] - Works with your existing downloaders, media servers, metadata sources and notification channels.[br] - Automatic organising: renaming, hardlinking, NFO/artwork scraping and media server refresh.[br] - Plugin and workflow system for extending behaviour without touching the core.[br][br] Setup notes:[br] - The web UI runs on port 3000. On first start open it and complete the setup wizard.[br] - Map /media and /downloads under the same Unraid share (for example /mnt/user/) so hardlinks work instead of copies.[br] - Settings live in /config/app.env and can also be edited from the web UI.[br][br] Documentation: https://wiki.movie-pilot.org[br] Project home: https://movie-pilot.org[br][br] This template is community maintained and is not produced by the MoviePilot authors. Support requests for the template belong in the Unraid support thread; bugs in MoviePilot itself belong upstream.[br][br] ===== 简体中文 =====[br] MoviePilot V3 是一款面向家庭影音库的自动化管理工具：自动订阅、搜索资源、调用已有的 BT 下载器下载，下载完成后自动重命名、硬链接、刮削元数据并通知媒体服务器刷新。[br][br] 使用提示：[br] - Web 界面端口为 3000，首次启动后打开页面完成初始化向导。[br] - /media 与 /downloads 请映射到同一个 Unraid 共享（例如 /mnt/user/）下，否则无法硬链接，只能复制。[br] - 配置保存在 /config/app.env，也可以在 Web 界面中修改。[br][br] 本模板由社区维护，非 MoviePilot 官方出品。模板相关问题请在 Unraid 支持贴反馈，程序本身的问题请到上游仓库反馈。
Container.Changes: ### 3.0.0 Initial Community Applications template for MoviePilot V3. V3 ships as its own image (jxxghp/moviepilot-v3); V2 stays on jxxghp/moviepilot-v2 and is not upgraded in place by this template.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the MoviePilot web interface.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Configuration, database and cache. Keep this on the cache/appdata share.

Config.Name: Media Library
Config.Description: Your media library, e.g. /mnt/user/media/. Must be on the same share as the download folder if you want hardlinks.

Config.Name: Downloads
Config.Description: The download folder used by your BitTorrent client, e.g. /mnt/user/downloads/. Must be on the same share as the media library if you want hardlinks.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the application runs as. 99 is the standard Unraid nobody user.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the application runs as. 100 is the standard Unraid users group.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File mode creation mask used for files written by the application.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Container timezone, e.g. Asia/Shanghai, Europe/Berlin, America/New_York.

Config.Name: NGINX_PORT
Config.Description: Port the built-in web server listens on inside the container. Change this only together with the WebUI Port mapping above.

Config.Name: PORT
Config.Description: Internal API port. Only change this if it clashes with something else inside the container.

Config.Name: MOVIEPILOT_AUTO_UPDATE
Config.Description: Update the application on container start: release, dev, or false to disable.

Config.Name: PROXY_HOST
Config.Description: Optional HTTP proxy used for outbound requests, e.g. http://user:password@192.168.1.2:7890

Config.Name: GITHUB_PROXY
Config.Description: Optional GitHub mirror prefix used when downloading updates and plugins, e.g. https://ghproxy.net/

Config.Name: GITHUB_TOKEN
Config.Description: Optional GitHub personal access token used to raise the API rate limit for updates and plugin downloads.

Config.Name: MOVIEPILOT_FORCE_CHOWN
Config.Description: Set to true for one start if the application reports permission errors on its cache directories. Slows down startup.

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Optional. Only needed by plugins that restart containers. Leave empty unless you use one of them.
